purpose: Generic condition evaluation library providing logical combinators (and/or/not), value operators (eq, contains, gt, regex, includes, etc.), and a pure evaluation engine with no domain knowledge
keyExports: evaluateValueCondition — evaluate a single value against a ValueCondition
evaluateFieldCondition — evaluate a Record<string, ValueCondition> against an object
factory — build ITestable<D> instances for logical and boolean conditions
AndCondition, OrCondition, NotCondition, BooleanCondition — composable condition classes
ValueCondition, StringOperators, NumberOperators, DateOperators, ArrayOperators, AnyCondition — type definitions

keyPatterns.name: Value evaluation
keyPatterns.description: Use evaluateValueCondition to test a primitive, array, or date against a declarative operator

keyPatterns.name: Logical composition
keyPatterns.description: Use AndCondition, OrCondition, NotCondition, or factory to compose nested conditions

architecture.keyDesign: Domain-agnostic core; field extraction and domain-specific factory logic live in consumer packages
